 A lot has changed at Paramount since last Black Friday , but its streaming discounts are staying the same. The company is bringing back its popular Paramount+ Black Friday deal , offering both its Essential and Premium plans for $2.99 per month for the first two months.
 The limited-time promotion, which launches ahead of Black Friday on Nov. 27, brings both Paramount+ Essential and Paramount+ Premium down to $2.99 per month for the first two months — a nearly 80% discount on the Premium plan (typically costs $13.99 per month) and a roughly 67% discount on the ad-supported Essential plan (regularly priced at $8.99 per month).

 SUBSCRIBE TO PARAMOUNT+ $2.99/Month 
 The deal is available through Nov. 30, just in time for the fourth and final season of “Yellowjackets” set to premiere Nov. 20. The platform is also home to Taylor Sheridan’s expanding television universe, including “Landman,” “Tulsa King,” “1883” and “1923,” alongside original series such as “MobLand,” “Mayor of Kingstown” and “Star Trek: Strange New Worlds.”
 For the same promotional price, subscribers can opt for Paramount+ Premium, which includes commercial-free on-demand viewing, access to Showtime programming, downloads for offline viewing and live streaming of local CBS stations. The Essential tier offers much of the same programming with advertisements, although certain Showtime titles and Premium features are excluded.
 Sports fans can also take advantage of the promotion to stream NFL games airing on CBS, UEFA Champions League matches and UFC programming. Premium subscribers additionally receive access to their local CBS station’s live feed.
 To claim the deal, subscribers can sign up directly through Paramount+’s website before Nov. 30. The promotion applies to monthly subscriptions only and is available to new customers and eligible former subscribers, with certain platform restrictions for returning users.
